title: geum idahoense
intro: Geum idahoense, commonly known as Idaho avens, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant is used in herbal medicine due to its various health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Geum idahoense include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as gastrointestinal issues and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
